Until now their new business came from referrals, trade fairs and the owner's network

pitch:
Passion4Growth (Sofia) works only with logistics, wholesale and manufacturing companies in CEE that are entering a new country or need to replace lost volume: we get you meetings with buyers there, beyond referrals and trade fairs.
Step 1, free: after one 30-minute call, within 5 working days we show you 15 real target companies in your niche and market, why each one fits, and the first message we would send them in the local language. If it does not look right, you walk away.
Step 2, the 90-day New-Market Pilot: EUR 500 to start (domains, inboxes, data). After that you pay only EUR 450 per qualified meeting that has taken place, at most 8 meetings (EUR 3,600 maximum). No meetings, nothing more to pay. Cancel any time.
Qualified means: a decision-maker (owner, buying, logistics or commercial lead) at a company you approved, in a call or visit about buying from you. We sign this definition together, and you can reject a meeting within 24 hours.
What we do: targeting, offer and outreach by email from separate warmed-up domains, LinkedIn and phone, in the local language, with each country's legal rules checked and a GDPR pack (checklist, legitimate-interest assessment, a contract that says who controls the data). You approve the target list and every first message; a person approves every reply. Before each meeting you get a one-page brief; after it we send the follow-ups until you have a quote request or a clear no. Your time: about 3 hours in total, plus the meetings.
Proof: a logistics client got 45 meetings in 2 months, and we put you in touch with a past client in the closest niche; if we have none in yours, we tell you before you pay anything.
